sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Blaze, Shadow Warden Captain (鬼差队长 火流星) is a story encounter in Pangzhen, found at In front of the South Gate bridge bell. Beating it yields Fire Meteor.

sections.title: Where to Find the Blaze, Shadow Warden Captain (鬼差队长 火流星)
sections.content:
Location: In front of the South Gate bridge bell.

Appears in: Pangzhen.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Blaze, Shadow Warden Captain (鬼差队长 火流星)
sections.content:
What works

  • Avoid the fire attacks and counter during recovery - the arena punishes standing still.
  • Bell placement in front of the South Gate marks the fight.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 23 of 60 in the progression order, in Pangzhen. Before it: Acolyte Yanru. After it: Cavalrybane (鬼差高手 斩骑). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
